name: Agents of Armageddon: Choice
source:
Satan’s baby son is captured by Heaven’s border patrol. What to do with the baby once the forces of Hell come knockin’?

Choice is a kinetic novel that serves as a prequel to The Night of the Creatures trilogy. It is an action packed story of what happened to Johnny Graves as a baby.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160213144207/http://stupidstupidgames.com/home/]official site[/url]]
translation:
撒旦的小儿子被天堂边境巡逻队抓获。一旦地狱的力量来袭，该如何处理婴儿呢？

《选择》是一部动态小说，是《生物之夜》三部曲的前传。这是一个充满动作的故事，讲述了约翰尼·格雷夫斯小时候发生的事情。

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160213144207/http://stupidstupidgames.com/home/]官方网站[/url]]
